penn-gcb.name: Cesar de la Fuente
penn-gcb.why: 近两年以末位作者提出用于肽/蛋白质定制设计的优化框架（key-cutting machine）和生成式 AI 肽优化方法，直接对应方向 B5 的 de novo 生成设计。
papers: Key-cutting machine: A novel optimization framework
Tailored structured peptide design
A generative artificial intelligence approach for peptide

penn-gcb.name: Eugene Katsevich
penn-gcb.why: 专门为单细胞 CRISPR 筛选开发统计推断方法（低 MOI 下的稳健差异表达检验、指数族测量误差模型），正对方向 A1。
papers: Robust differential expression testing for single-cell CRISPR
Exponential family measurement error models for single-cell CRISPR
Saddlepoint approximations for plug-in resampling

penn-gcb.name: Jin Jin
penn-gcb.why: 开发基于 GWAS summary statistics 的多祖源贝叶斯 PRS（MUSSEL）和潜变量暴露的孟德尔随机化方法，同时覆盖方向 A3 的 PGS 与 MR。
papers: MUSSEL: Enhanced Bayesian polygenic risk prediction
Bayesian Mendelian Randomization Analysis for Latent Exposures
Mendelian randomization analysis using multiple biomarkers

penn-gcb.name: Bogdan Pasaniuc
penn-gcb.why: 将多基因风险与单细胞甲基化数据整合（met-scDRS），并参与跨生物库的局部祖源感知关联分析框架，属方向 A3 统计遗传学方法。
papers: Integration of polygenic risk with single cell methylation data
Integration of polygenic risk with single cell methylation profiles
A unified framework for local-ancestry-aware

penn-gcb.name: Gregory R. Bowman
penn-gcb.why: 用计算模拟研究蛋白质构象动力学与相互作用界面（抗体成熟如何改变接触区刚性、同源寡聚体对称性预测），与方向 B6 结构预测及 B4 抗体亲和力相关。
papers: Antibody maturation increases rigidity
Rapid and accurate prediction of protein homo-oligomer symmetry
G Protein Activation Occurs via a Largely Universal Mechanism

penn-gcb.name: Marylyn D Ritchie
penn-gcb.why: 开发基于 GWAS summary statistics 的贝叶斯位点识别方法（SABER），并研究 PGS 在不同人群队列中的表现差异，属方向 A3。
papers: SABER: Statistical Identification of Loci of Interest
Risk factors affecting polygenic score performance
CASTER-DTA: equivariant graph neural networks

penn-gcb.name: Dokyoon Kim
penn-gcb.why: 研究 PRS 中样本重叠造成的过拟合偏差，并比较蛋白组评分与 PRS 的互补预测能力，属方向 A3 多基因评分方法。
papers: Addressing overfitting bias due to sample overlap
Plasma protein-based and polygenic risk scores
Pathway Modeling of Genomic and Tissue-Specific

penn-gcb.name: Sara Mathieson
penn-gcb.why: 用自监督 transformer 和 CNN 做群体遗传推断（自然选择信号检测），属计算基因组学方法，但偏群体遗传而非 GWAS/MR。
papers: Popformer: Learning general signatures of positive selection
Interpreting convolutional neural networks in population genetics
Fast pairwise coalescence enables

yale-cbb.name: Zhao, Hongyu
yale-cbb.why: 末位作者开发统计遗传方法：用 knockoff 提升条件 TWAS 的因果基因识别，并联合个体级与 summary-level GWAS 数据估计遗传相关，覆盖方向 A2/A3。
papers: Knockoff procedure improves causal gene identifications
Estimating genetic correlation jointly using individual-level
Joint modeling of effect sizes for two correlated traits

yale-cbb.name: Zhou, Xiang
yale-cbb.why: 开发生物库规模的统计遗传工具：基因–环境交互检测（fastGxE）、PGS 校准预测区间和基于 summary statistics 的性别二态性 fine-mapping，属方向 A3。
papers: Genome-wide detection of genotype–environment interactions
Statistical construction of calibrated prediction intervals
Sex-dimorphic fine-mapping with summary statistics

yale-cbb.name: Guan, Leying
yale-cbb.why: 提出利用遗传相关和多人群信息的多祖源 PRS 框架（JointPRS），属方向 A3 多基因评分方法。
papers: JointPRS: A data-adaptive framework
Leveraging genetic correlations and multiple populations
A supervised Bayesian factor model

yale-cbb.name: Krishnaswamy, Smita
yale-cbb.why: 用几何感知 flow matching 建模扰动条件下的单细胞动态，并用神经 ODE 推断时序调控网络，对应方向 A1（扰动预测）与 A2（网络推断）。
papers: GeoSinkhorn Flow: Geometry-Aware Flow Matching
Revealing dynamic temporal regulatory networks
ViSENet: Joint Sequence and Structure Embeddings

yale-cbb.name: Rodríguez Martínez, María
yale-cbb.why: 同时做单细胞/空间扰动表型预测模型（Pop-Corn）和 TCR–MHC 体系中生成式肽骨架设计的基准评测，横跨方向 A1 与 B5。
papers: Pop-Corn: Predicting Perturbation Phenotype Effects
Benchmarking generative scaffold design methods
Cell-specific gene networks and drivers

yale-cbb.name: Kleinstein, Steven
yale-cbb.why: 对预训练抗体语言模型做监督微调以预测抗原特异性，并用语言模型嵌入 BCR 序列，对应方向 B4 的抗体计算方法。
papers: Supervised fine-tuning of pre-trained antibody language models
Language model-based B cell receptor sequence embeddings
AMULETY: A Python package

yale-cbb.name: O'Hern, Corey
yale-cbb.why: 用图神经网络设计蛋白–蛋白界面打分函数并系统评估界面模型打分，正对方向 B6 的复合物/界面预测。
papers: Designing a Protein-Protein Interface Scoring Function
Assessment of scoring functions for computational models of protein-protein interfaces

yale-cbb.name: Machta, Benjamin
yale-cbb.why: 用蛋白语言模型的 pseudo-perplexity 估计蛋白适应度，并研究低序列重叠蛋白间的高适应度路径，与方向 B5 的序列生成/优化相关。
papers: Pseudo-perplexity in one fell swoop
High fitness paths can connect proteins
Protein-protein interaction networks can be highly sensitive

stanford-biophysics.name: Brian Hie
stanford-biophysics.why: 末位作者开发结构感知蛋白语言模型做抗体复合物的无监督进化、用 ProteinDPO 将生成模型对齐实验适应度，并生成表位定向的 de novo 抗体，同时命中方向 B4 与 B5。
papers: Unsupervised evolution of protein and antibody complexes
Aligning protein-generative models to experimental fitness
Efficient generation of epitope-targeted de novo antibodies

stanford-biophysics.name: Possu Huang
stanford-biophysics.why: 开发条件蛋白结构生成模型（Protpardelle-1c）和集成条件序列设计，并实现零样本 de novo 金属酶设计，正对方向 B5。
papers: Conditional Protein Structure Generation with Protpardelle-1c
Zero-shot design of a de novo metalloenzyme
Isolation of structural constraints by ensemble-conditioned

stanford-biophysics.name: Peter Kim
stanford-biophysics.why: 用结构感知语言模型对蛋白复合物做 inverse folding，实现抗体的无监督进化（亲和力提升），对应方向 B4 与 B5。
papers: Inverse folding of protein complexes with a structure-informed language model
Unsupervised evolution of protein and antibody complexes
Design of universal Ebola virus vaccine candidates

stanford-biophysics.name: Grant Rotskoff
stanford-biophysics.why: 开发无序蛋白区域的生成式设计（IDiom）和基于 transformer 的构象系综生成，以及少样本定向进化方法，属方向 B5/B6。
papers: Generative design of intrinsically disordered protein regions with IDiom
Data-Efficient Generation of Protein Conformational Ensembles
Efficient, Few-Shot Directed Evolution

stanford-biophysics.name: Ron Dror
stanford-biophysics.why: 在推理阶段从扩散模型中挖掘生物分子构象景观，并用预测配体结合姿态辅助结构模型选择，属方向 B6 结构预测。
papers: Unlocking hidden biomolecular conformational landscapes
Protein Structural Model Selection Informed by Comparison
Enhancing Ligand Pose Sampling

stanford-biophysics.name: Xiaojing Gao
stanford-biophysics.why: 参与表位定向 de novo 抗体生成（Germinal），并提出对蛋白生成模型做生成式引导以适配新环境，对应方向 B4/B5。
papers: Efficient generation of epitope-targeted de novo antibodies
Generative steering to adapt proteins
Steering Protein Generative Models at Test-Time

stanford-biophysics.name: Russ Altman
stanford-biophysics.why: 改进上下文感知的蛋白嵌入（GATSBI）并用局部结构嵌入注释蛋白功能位点，与方向 B6 的结构表征学习相关。
papers: GATSBI: Improving context-aware protein embeddings
Protein functional site annotation using local structure embeddings
Drug-Target Interaction Prediction with PIGLET

stanford-biophysics.name: Michael Snyder
stanford-biophysics.why: 提出单细胞多基因风险评分以解析复杂疾病的细胞异质性，并用机器学习纳入罕见变异改进风险预测，属方向 A3（本项目中偏 A 方向的老师）。
papers: Single-cell polygenic risk scores dissect
Machine Learning Reveals the Contribution of Rare Genetic Variants
Dissecting the genetic complexity of myalgic encephalomyelitis

uw-bpsd.name: David Baker
uw-bpsd.why: 末位作者持续发表 de novo 蛋白设计与全原子结构预测引导的设计优化（RFOptimization、序列特异性 DNA 结合蛋白生成、PLACER），是方向 B5/B6 的核心实验室。
papers: Generative design of sequence specific DNA binding proteins
RFOptimization: Guiding Design Optimization
Modeling protein–small molecule conformational ensembles with PLACER

uw-bpsd.name: Neil King
uw-bpsd.why: 用 ProteinMPNN 等工具计算设计双组分/双面蛋白纳米材料和带功能基序的 de novo 纳米颗粒，属方向 B5。
papers: Rapid and automated design of two-component protein nanomaterials
De novo design of protein nanoparticles with integrated functional motifs
Computational design of bifaceted protein nanomaterials

uw-bpsd.name: Frank DiMaio
uw-bpsd.why: 开发 RoseTTAFoldNA 复合物结构预测和 RF3/AtomWorks 建模框架，并用设计实验结果改进能量函数，正对方向 B6 与 B5。
papers: Accurate prediction of protein–nucleic acid complexes using RoseTTAFoldNA
Accelerating Biomolecular Modeling with AtomWorks and RF3
Using experimental results of protein design

uw-bpsd.name: Gaurav Bhardwaj
uw-bpsd.why: 用 AlphaFold2 做环肽结构预测与设计，并用深度学习 de novo 设计高亲和力蛋白结合大环肽，属方向 B5/B6。
papers: Cyclic peptide structure prediction and design using AlphaFold2
Accurate de novo design of high-affinity protein-binding macrocycles
A scalable recombinant pipeline

uw-bpsd.name: Phil Bradley
uw-bpsd.why: 设计靶向肽–MHC 的 TCR 和抗体，并参与抗体自然选择的 transformer 模型和蛋白微环境卷积网络，对应方向 B4/B5。
papers: Targeting peptide–MHC complexes with designed T cell receptors
A Sitewise Model of Natural Selection on Individual Antibodies
Learning the shape of protein microenvironments

uw-bpsd.name: David Veesler
uw-bpsd.why: 做病毒融合蛋白稳定化与设计型纳米颗粒疫苗的结构研究，并研究广谱中和抗体，与方向 B4（抗体）和 B5（设计蛋白）相关，但以实验结构生物学为主。
papers: A broadly generalizable stabilization strategy
Hierarchical design of pseudosymmetric protein nanocages
Pan-neutralization of parainfluenza viruses

uw-bpsd.name: Liangcai Gu
uw-bpsd.why: 参与用 AI 框架从全蛋白组中发现类结合蛋白支架，并构建化学诱导二聚化结合体系，与方向 B5 的结合蛋白设计相关。
papers: Artificial intelligence-driven framework for discovering synthetic binding
Linker-Length Landscape Mapping
Picomolar-Level Sensing of Cannabidiol

unc-biostat.name: Yun Li
unc-biostat.why: 提出考虑混合祖源的 LASSO 多基因评分框架并显式建模祖源差异效应以改进混合人群 PRS，属方向 A3。
papers: An efficient LASSO framework for admixture-aware polygenic scores
Improving polygenic risk prediction in admixed populations
Weak signal inclusion under dependence

unc-biostat.name: Hongtu Zhu
unc-biostat.why: 开发面向大规模影像表型的高效 GWAS 计算方法和联邦双重机器学习，属方向 A3 统计遗传方法（偏影像遗传）。
papers: Computation and resource efficient genome-wide association analysis
Federated double machine learning
Connectome-based spatial statistics

unc-biostat.name: Xihao Li
unc-biostat.why: 提出整合常见与罕见变异的两样本孟德尔随机化框架和多人群 PRS 方法，同时覆盖方向 A3 的 MR 与 PGS。
papers: A novel two-sample Mendelian randomization framework
Integrating common and rare variants improves polygenic risk prediction
Integrating Genomic and Proteomic Data

unc-biostat.name: Danyu Lin
unc-biostat.why: 研究暴露变量测量不完整时的多变量孟德尔随机化，并参与整合 GWAS 与单细胞数据推断相关细胞类型（EPIC），属方向 A3。
papers: Multivariable Mendelian randomization with incomplete measurements
EPIC: Inferring relevant cell types

unc-biostat.name: Fei Zou
unc-biostat.why: 提出带测量误差校正的线性混合模型，用于基于 summary data 的多变量孟德尔随机化，属方向 A3。
papers: A Linear Mixed Model With Measurement Error Correction

unc-biostat.name: Michael Love
unc-biostat.why: 参与揭示相邻基因共调控如何干扰 eQTL 靶基因优先级判断，以及基因–处理交互检测方法，与方向 A2/A3 的因果基因推断相关。
papers: Extensive co-regulation of neighboring genes
DetectGxT: detecting gene-by-treatment interactions
